SELECT h.tenant_id,h.project_id,h.task_id,h.status,h.revision,h.owner_id,t.task_revision,t.profile_revision, t.snapshot_id,t.template_version,t.agent_release_id,t.plan_revision,t.content_sha256,v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,h.updated_at FROM task_head h LEFT JOIN task_revision t ON t.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND t.project_id=h.project_id AND t.task_id=h.task_id AND t.task_revision=h.current_revision LEFT JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND v.version_id=t.task_revision AND v.owner_project_id=t.project_id AND v.entity_kind='TASK_REVISION' WHERE h.task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.project_id,s.snapshot_id,s.manifest,s.manifest_sha256,s.auth_epoch,s.governance_epoch,s.created_at, v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash FROM scope_snapshot s LEFT JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.version_id=s.snapshot_id AND v.owner_project_id=s.project_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId}

SELECT p.plan_revision,p.task_revision,p.template_version,p.snapshot_id,p.status,p.decision_id,c.content_json, p.content_sha256,v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,c.schema_ref,c.schema_version,c.schema_manifest_sha256 FROM plan_revision p JOIN plan_content_revision c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.project_id=p.project_id AND c.task_id=p.task_id AND c.task_revision=p.task_revision AND c.plan_revision=p.plan_revision AND c.template_version=p.template_version AND c.snapshot_id=p.snapshot_id AND c.content_sha256=p.content_sha256 JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND v.version_id=p.plan_revision AND v.owner_project_id=p.project_id AND v.entity_kind='PLAN_REVISION' WHERE p.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.task_id=#{taskId} AND p.plan_revision=#{planRevision}
SELECT document_id FROM document_head d WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY document_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT run_id,status,revision FROM task_run r WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_INPUT','CANCEL_REQUESTED') ORDER BY run_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT waiting_item_id,project_id,run_id,target_revision,reason_code,question,requirement_refs,allowed_resolution_actions, assignee_id,status,revision,schema_version,updated_at FROM waiting_item w WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND status='WAITING_INPUT' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_run r WHERE r.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND r.project_id=w.project_id AND r.run_id=w.run_id AND r.task_id=#{taskId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_revision t WHERE t.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND t.project_id=w.project_id AND t.task_revision=w.target_revision AND t.task_id=#{taskId})) ORDER BY waiting_item_id FOR UPDATE
